title: ds42 participant registry entry
description: One participant's declaration of a role on ds42.org. File path: entries/<role>/<slug>.yaml, where <role> and <slug> must match this entry's own 'role' and 'slug' fields.

role.description: Which of ds42's four membership roles (ADR-0009) this entry declares.

slug.description: Short, URL-safe identifier for this participant. Must match the entry's own file name.

contact.description: A GitHub handle or URL a stranger can use to reach this participant.

date_registered.description: YYYY-MM-DD this entry was first submitted.

description.description: Optional free-text: what this participant runs or offers.

trust_model.description: Authority role only: the trust model this authority operates under (DID/SSI, eIDAS2/PKI, from-scratch, etc.).

claims_issued.description: Authority role only: what claims/credentials this authority issues, and to whom.

onboarding_url.description: Authority role only: where a participant goes to onboard and request a credential.
